weeks.title: Week 1: Step Acquisitions & Control Transition
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Step Acquisitions & Control Transition

Learning Objectives

  • Account for step acquisition (ASC 805-10)
  • Remeasure previously held equity interest to FV
  • Calculate goodwill on the acquisition date

Key Topics

1. Increase from equity method to control

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Increase from equity method to control. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Increase from equity method to control concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Increase from equity method to control is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: step acquisitions & control transition concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Increase from equity method to control for exam success and professional competence

  • Master Goodwill calculation for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 3: Spin-Offs & Split-Offs
weeks.lessonHtml:
